title: Online trace resolves quote id from hardcoded literal "quote_id" with precedence over the configured qid_col, contradicting the filter on line 185
description: In `_explain_online`, the artifact's quote-id column is read via `qid_col = _required_artifact_column(artifact, "quote_id", default="quote_id")` (line 156) and is what both the price_contour applier (`ApplyOptimiser(quote_id=qid_col)`, line 173) and the candidate filter (`explained.filter(pl.col(qid_col).cast(pl.Utf8) == str(quote_id_value))`, line 185) operate on. But the *value* used in that filter is resolved on line 179 as `quote_id_value = output_row.get("quote_id", output_row.get(qid_col))`, which gives the literal key `"quote_id"` precedence over the configured `qid_col`. When the artifact configures a non-default quote-id column (e.g. `quote_id="policy_ref"`), and the output row also carries a literal `quote_id` column (which the route layer can legitimately add — see `routes/_optimiser_service.py:1971-1972` preferring a literal `quote_id` when present), the value taken from the wrong column is then filtered against the *correct* `qid_col` column on line 185, so no rows match and the trace raises a spurious `OptimiserApplyTraceError("no optimiser candidates found for quote_id=...")`. A second facet: because `dict.get("quote_id", default)` only uses the default when the key is *absent*, a present-but-null literal `quote_id` (value `None`) shadows a valid configured-column value and forces the `quote_id_value is None` branch (line 180-183) to raise even though the configured column holds a real id. Correct behaviour is to prefer the configured `qid_col` and only fall back to the literal `"quote_id"`, i.e. `output_row.get(qid_col, output_row.get("quote_id"))`, and to treat null as missing.
evidence: L156 qid_col=_required_artifact_column(artifact,"quote_id",default="quote_id") -> may be e.g. "policy_ref". L179 quote_id_value=output_row.get("quote_id", output_row.get(qid_col)) -> picks literal-quote_id value (or None if key present but null) BEFORE the configured column. L185 explained.filter(pl.col(qid_col).cast(pl.Utf8)==str(quote_id_value)) -> filters on policy_ref using the quote_id-column value; mismatch => quote_rows.is_empty() => L189 raise 'no optimiser candidates found'. All tests (test_optimiser_apply_trace_enrichment.py) use qid_col=='quote_id', so the divergent-column path is unexercised.
